name: upper_limb_use
paper_title: Quantification of the relative arm use in patients with hemiparesis using inertial measurement units
authors: Ann David, S. ReethaJanetSureka, S. Gayathri, S. J. Annamalai, S. Samuelkamleshkumar, A. Kuruvilla, H. P. Magimairaj, S. Varadhan, S. Balasubramanian
venue: Journal of Rehabilitation and Assistive Technologies Engineering 8:20556683211019694
license: Dataset/code: see the source repository. Paper: open access.
notes: This is the primary publication identified by the dataset repository. Ten unimpaired controls and five hemiparetic stroke survivors performed 15 activities of daily living wearing a custom wrist-worn IMU on BOTH wrists; therapists annotated upper-limb functional use from video on the FAABOS scale. The repository README documents the column layout (time, ax..az, gx..gz, pitch, yaw, mx..mz, subject, old_time, r1, r2, g1, g2, task, use_type, gnd) and 50 Hz; both were verified (median clock step 20.000 ms). VERIFIED AT CONVERT TIME: acceleration is in g with gravity present (median |acc| 1.016 g) and angular rate in rad/s (p99.9 6.80). Control and patient cohorts number subjects independently, so ids are prefixed c/p. The released CSVs do not record which anatomical side is affected, so patient streams are described by impairment rather than left/right. Blank task rows are unlabelled gaps and are dropped. 682 of 1,042 task runs are shorter than a 6 s window.
